contexts.text: Thousands of objections would inflow, which would strengthen his mind in the negative.
Evil Spirits strongly inspire what is negative.
He who succumbs in temptation... falls into what is negative.
In the feeling of anger in which these things are said, there is what is negative.

Those think from the negative who believe nothing unless they are convinced by rational and scientific things, nay, by sensuous things... Those who are in the negative in regard to a thing being true because it is in the Word, say at heart that they will believe when they are persuaded by rational and scientific things. But the fact is that they never believe; and indeed they would not believe if they were to be convinced by the very sensuous things of the body... for they would always form new reasonings against those things, and thus end by completely extinguishing all faith, and at the same time turning the light of the Rational into darkness, because into falsities.
Those who incline to a life of evil, fall (from doubt) into the negative... Example(s).
If it is shown them a thousand... times that it is so, they still propose negative doubts...
The more anyone is endowed with talent and knowledge, and is in the negative, the more insane he is...
When they come to adult age, they admit negatives, even to an affection for falsity.
Negatives of truth are represented by dark and descending clouds.
In regard to falsities, they do not reason whether it is so or not, but they affirm instantly; whereas in regard to goods and truths they have continual reasoning, which terminates in a negative.
He who is in a dubitative negative, which in itself is a negative, and says that he does not believe until he is persuaded by scientifics, never believes. References.

They who have not faith from revelation cannot be confirmed from nature... nor from miracles. The reason is that they are in the negative; and, when this reigns, everything is brought there, or is so explained that it agrees with it, chiefly because they are in the lumen of nature not illustrated by the light of Heaven; for exteriors can be seen from interiors, or posterior things from prior ones, and effects from causes; but not the reverse.
Those meant by the dragon... deduce all things to a negative.
For evil is recipient of what is negative.
All who reason from sensuous, scientific, and philosophical things, deny that there is spirit...

They who consult sensuous and scientific things concerning matters of belief, precipitate themselves not only into doubt, but also into denial, that is, into thick darkness, (and thus) into all cupidities...
Because (they reason) from self... they cannot do otherwise than deny, and when they deny, they also blaspheme and profane.
They who care nothing for the Word... thus denying principles, are called drunkards without wine.
Preface. Still, at heart they deny (the resurrection.)
The Sadducees openly denied the resurrection; but did better than those at this day who say that they do not deny... and yet deny at heart.
Hence it is evident, that the truths of faith can never be acknowledged as truths... unless they are implanted in charity; for interiorly they are denied at heart.
Sarah denied... () = that human rational truth wanted to excuse itself.
Under Affirm, see this reference, and at AC 2568:4. AC 2689:3. AC 3221. AC 3913. AC 3923:4. AC 4096:6. AC 4459:2. AC 4638:4. AC 4760. HH 356. SE 3614. SE 4536. DMin 4580.
The denial of the Divine Human and of the Holy proceeding of the Lord. Signified.
This all they deny at heart who are in the life of evil... Better did the Pharisees, who openly denied the Divine of the Lord...
Lest they should... deny the Divine Human and the Holy proceeding of the Lord. Signified.
The reason they who are in evil within the Church reject charity more than they deny the Lord, is...
Such within the Church deny the Lord in secret.
When the doctrine of faith is regarded from rational things... it not only becomes none, but whatever is therein is denied.

The principle which leads to all folly and insanity is to deny all things... until one is convinced by those things which he can apprehend or feel... this is to be called the negative principle... They who think from the negative principle... at last deny all things.

There are some in doubt before they deny, and some before they affirm; they who are in doubt before they deny, are they who incline to a life of evil; and when this life carries them away, the more they think about these things the more they deny them.
That they who are in the mere knowledge of Knowledges would deny these things. Signified. To stop up = not to want to know, and, what is the same, to deny; thus to obliterate.
He, therefore, who teaches what is to be done, and does not do it, does not want to know truths; for they are against his life, and the things which are against his life he denies.

Denial on account of these things. Signified. To quarrel, or contend = to deny... Ezek or contention = the denial of the internal sense of the Word; the causes of the denial are also in the same word.
They who are in the mere knowledge of Knowledges... cannot do otherwise than deny that there is an internal sense of the Word. Explained.
Sitnah = opposition, which is a further degree of denial.
That their doctrinal things of faith regarded in themselves should not be denied, namely, so far as they are from the literal sense of the Word. Signified, Explained.
The Christian world denies at heart that the Word is so Divine.
They shall kill you, that is, by denial.
This good cannot inflow into what is negative...
That they were in the Negative of all the things which are of faith and its doctrine. Signified.
He first acknowledges and believes... and then denies... They who once acknowledge at heart, and afterwards deny, are they who profane.
Evil Spirits... are adjoined in order to induce the negative things which are to be dispelled, so that the man may be the better confirmed in truths and goods.
Christians who have not lived in charity, have closed Heaven against themselves, very many so that it cannot be opened; for they know truths and deny them...
They who deny or despise the Lord (are in fatuous lumen).
That on account of the disagreement of the natural man, it is better to be in simple good, although in the denial of truth, is signified by to enter halt into life.

Although these things appear incredible, still they are not to be denied, because experience itself dictates them. If all things of which the causes are not known were to be denied, innumerable things which come forth in nature would be denied, the causes of which are known scarcely as to the one ten thousandth part... How much more is this the case with the arcana which come forth in the sphere above nature! Example(s).
That there is any internal sense... he denies.
Fallacies from sensuous things, by means of which the truths of the Church cannot be seen; concerning which, therefore, they are in negative doubt. Signified.
He does indeed wish to know how the case is with Heaven, etc., but when he is told, he yet believes nothing, because at heart he denies their existence...
Many of those who come from the Christian world, who also have preached the Lord in the world, there utterly deny Him...
This supreme or inmost truth, that the Human of the Lord is Divine, is denied by those in the Church who are in faith alone.
Hence it is evident, that those who are in the Negative, if they consult scientifics, cast themselves more into falsities...
The learned consult scientifics... from the Negative, and thereby destroy in themselves all insight from above or within...
Heaven is never denied to anyone by the Lord.
If he then denies them, it is a sign that he is in evil...
The things which are higher or more interior, he at heart denies.
There are very many within the Church who deny the Lord, and say that they acknowledge a Supreme Being.
Because they deny all that which is called spiritual... There thence come forth many things which the man who attributes all things to nature either denies, or ascribes to a more occult nature.
Thus it happens that when they have inverted heavenly order in this way, they at last deny Divine things, those which are of Heaven, and consequently those which are of charity and faith...
If it were demonstrated, they would not believe, because the Negative universally reigns.

They who do not believe unless scientific and sensuous things dictate, and who are in the Negative to begin with, never believe; the reason is, that the Negative universally reigns, and when this universally reigns, the scientifics which deny flow in and are gathered together, but those which confirm... are rejected to the sides, or are explained in favour of the denying scientifics, and thus the Negative is strengthened.
With those who are in the Negative, that is, those with whom the Negative universally reigns, doubts can never be removed, for with them one scruple avails more than a thousand confirmations.
But these Spirits attended but little to these things, because they were in the Negative.
Under Daughter, see this reference.
Under Profane, see these references. AC 6963:end.
If the internal man afterwards denies that which miracles have confirmed, there takes place an opposition and collision of the internal and external man... thus profanation.
Miracles would effect still less at this day... when everything (spiritual) is denied; for there universally reigns a Negative against the Divine influx and government...
Hence it is, that after a man has falsified truths, he at last utterly denies them...
With those in whom they are extinguished, the good which is of love and the truth which is of faith are denied, and the evils and falsities which are contrary are affirmed.
Under Temptation, see this reference.
The Lord is not in the truths with man, when he denies Him and His Divine.

Living experience from those in the other life, who in their heart have denied that the Word is inspired from the Divine... It was observed that they had lived at their pleasure, and that therefore in their hearts they had denied the Divine, Heaven and Hell, the life after death, and all other matters of faith.

Denial in every way of the Lord and His Kingdom by those who are of the Church, and thus the profanation of the good and truth of the Church. Signified... To curse = aversion and disjunction, thus also denial in every way; for he who averts and disjoins himself from the Lord, denies Him at heart.
Hence it is, that the denial of the Lord is not profanation with those who are outside the Church.

It is here said of God that He is to be feared, because He is able to destroy soul and body in Gehenna, when yet He destroys no one; but still it is true; wherefore, it is not to be extinguished, that is, denied; for if it is denied, faith in the Word perishes...

This is attributed to the Lord in the sense of the letter, because it so appears; therefore, as it is an apparent truth, it is not to be denied, that is, extinguished; for thus faith for the Word would be extinguished, which faith is with the simple. References.
Truth Divine is the Word and is doctrine from the Word; they who deny these at heart, blaspheme, even if they praise and preach it; blasphemy lies concealed in the denial...

They who blaspheme or deny the Word, cannot receive anything of the truth and good of faith... Wherefore, they who deny the Word cannot receive anything that the Word teaches; for when they read or hear it, there occurs what is negative, which either extinguishes the truth or turns it into falsity.

When the Divine truth and good which is from the Lord is denied, it is extinguished with the man, thus so is the Lord Himself... This truth and good is extinguished, when the Divine of the Lord is denied, and also when the Word is; for this is Divine truth from the Lord and concerning the Lord; to deny this, when it has been first acknowledged and received in faith, and thus to extinguish it, is the sin against the Holy Spirit, which is not remitted.
When the truths of faith and the goods of love are denied at heart, the man spiritually dies.
What is abortive and barren = vastations and denials of good and truth.
Its waves = ratiocinations therefrom, and thence denials.
To speak against Divine truth, or to deny it, when once it has been acknowledged, is profanation.
Let everyone within the Church therefore beware lest he deny the Lord, and also lest he deny His Divine; for to this denial Heaven is closed and Hell is open...

Hence may be evident, what is the nature of the lot in the other life of those who are born within the Church, and still at heart deny the Lord, whatever may be their character in moral life; by much experience it has been given to know, that they cannot be saved. Signified.
The triple denial (of the Lord by Peter) = the plenary denial of the Lord at the end of the Church.

These words to Peter signified the denial of the Lord in the Church, when its end comes: for the Lord is denied when there is no longer any faith, and faith is not where there is no longer any charity.
Hence it is, that the merely natural man... at heart denies Divine and heavenly things...
Hence it is, that those who have taken delight in adulteries, afterwards hold cheap and also at heart deny those things which are of the Church and Heaven.
He who denies the Lord is in evils and falsities; for good and truth come from no other Source than He.

That the evils of the love of self and the world induce such ignorance... is very manifest from those within the Church, who, although they know from revelation that there is a God, etc., still fall into denial concerning these things; as well the learned as the unlearned.
They who are in externals without an internal... in their heart deny the Divine.
With those who deny (the truths of faith from the Word), the internal is entirely closed...
Such are they who deny these universals (of the Church).
As (those with whom the love of self and the love of the world make the life) receive nothing from Heaven, in their heart they deny God and the life after death...

They who at heart have denied the Divine, however they may have confessed it with the mouth, become so stupid, that they can scarcely comprehend any civil truth, still less any spiritual one... The interiors of their minds are so closed up that they appear black...
For the most part they are tied to some infernal Society, because such have also denied the Divine...

Quite contrary is the state of those who in the world have lived in evil, and who have no conscience, and thence have denied the Divine; for all who live in evil, interiorly in themselves deny the Divine...
Hence it is that as with those who love themselves and the world above all things the higher things of the mind are closed, at heart they deny Divine truths...
In these Hells are all those who have acknowledged nature and have denied the Divine...
The denial of God makes Hell; and, in Christendom, the denial of the Lord's Divinity.
If man manifestly saw the Divine Providence, he would either deny God, or make himself God. General article. DP 183, Explained.
As they then manifestly see the Divine Providence... which is that they are to come into Hell, they not only deny God, but also blaspheme Him.
When such are elevated into Heaven... they do not see anything; as I have seen done with many who have denied the Divine Providence of the Lord.
But this cannot be done, if a man first acknowledges the truths of faith, and lives according to them, and afterwards recedes from and denies them. Explained.

He who does not know holy things, cannot acknowledge them, and afterwards deny them... It would be otherwise if (the Jews) were to receive and acknowledge it, and afterwards were to deny it, which, however, is rarely done; many of them acknowledge it exteriorly, and deny it interiorly, and are like hypocrites. But those profane holy things by a commingling of them with profane ones, who first receive and acknowledge, and afterwards depart and deny.
If as a man grows up he acknowledges truths and lives according to them, and afterwards denies them, he commingles holy with profane things.
The sixth kind of profanation is from those who acknowledge the Word, yet deny the Divine of the Lord. Explained.

The seventh kind of profanation is from those who first acknowledge Divine truths, and live according to them, and afterwards recede from and deny them. This is the worst kind of profanation. Explained.
Wherefore, he can use these things as arguments to deny (the Divine Providence).
The acknowledgement of God makes the conjunction of God with man and of man with God, and the denial of God makes the separation. General article.
They who deny God in the world, deny Him after death.
Thou hast not denied My name () = that they are in the worship of the Lord.
Thou art neither cold nor hot = that those who are such now deny that the Word is Divine and holy, and now acknowledge that it is so.
Such are the same in relation to God, now they deny and now they acknowledge Him; in like manner in relation to all things of the Church.

At this day that there is one God is not denied, but that the Lord is He, is denied. That the Church is from Him who is the Saviour and Redeemer is not denied; but that He is to be immediately approached as the Saviour and Redeemer, is denied...
These cannot do otherwise than interiorly in themselves deny God; for this lies stored up in a life of evil confirmed by falsities.
Then, on account of his denial of God, he is damned.
Hence it is evident, that he who denies God is already among the damned, and, after death, he is gathered to his own.
The minds of all men who deny the holiness of the Word and the Divinity of the Lord, think in the lowest region (of the mind).

All they are evil who deny the creation of the world by God, and thus deny God; for they are naturalistic atheists... Wherefore, they who deny God do not will and therefore are not able to receive any good from any source than their own proprium...

There were some Spirits who denied; but it was perceived by others, that they said this from malignity... which they also confessed, saying, that they wanted to be potent with the licence of saying and denying.

As this is the truth, there should be no ratiocination about the truth of the thing from causes; and if no causes are found, the truth is not to be invalidated or denied, as is usually the case; but being the truth it ought to be believed; if they want to investigate the causes, they may do so... provided that if they do not find the cause... the truth be not therefore denied; it is as with almost all things in nature... if all things were denied because the causes are not found, there would be no natural truth.
In the ideas (of the simple at heart), there is no such doubt and Negative, as there is in the ideas of those who suppose that they are wise from themselves.

It has sometimes happened, that they who in life have preached heavenly truths... denied them when they were demonstrated in the other life, because they had been in a state of ratiocination concerning them. Example(s).
That by means of disputations the Knowledges of faith may be brought to denial.

Those things which in themselves are manifest, and are in light, if they come into discussion, come into obscurity or ignorance, and from ignorance or obscurity into doubt, and from doubt into denial.

Those with whom the Lord has rooted and confirmed the Knowledges of faith, although from the sphere of persuasions they seem to themselves to be driven as it were into denial, still it is dispelled... and the denial is driven away, then the doubt, and then the obscurity...
If those who do not believe were taken into Heaven, and were to acknowledge and confess; when let back, they at once deny as before that Heaven exists.
That delights and pleasures are never denied to man.
They have never been denied to me...
On those who deny God confirmatively...
They from whom this sphere (of violation) exhales, are they who in their heart deny the Divine, and those things which are of the Church; but outwardly appear civil, bland, moral.
On those who do not think anything about the Divine, but still do not deny these things.
Thou hast not denied the faith () = constancy in truths. Not to deny, when predicated of faith = to be constant; for he who is constant, does not deny.
Thou hast not denied My name = that they acknowledge the Divine of the Lord in His Human.
Love draws... the thoughts into its own side; wherefore, when they think in solitude they entirely deny the things they confess with the mouth before the world.

The sin against the Holy Spirit is the denial of the Lord in the Word; for they who deny this, tacitly and at heart deny all things of Heaven and the Church, because all these are from the Word; and they deny that the Lord is Divine.
To deny the Divine of the Lord, and thus the Word, is the sin against the Holy Spirit.
Everything of love and faith depends thereon; wherefore, they who deny God, because there is disjunction from Him, are in Hell.
